tasks.intent:
Read spec/task.md, interface.json and the typed CSIR behavioral contract.
Implement the exact top-level interface and all behavior in rtl/. Develop with
python3 tools/check.py and optional tests/designer/. Write only rtl/, tests/designer/
and build/. Do not modify the task, checker, workflow or permissions, inspect
other trials or final evaluators, or invoke extra models/agents. Repair actionable
feedback within the shared 1200-second frontend budget. Return
NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"rtl":{"module":"the exact requested top-level module"}}.

tasks.intent:
Independently inspect and test delivered RTL against spec/task.md and
interface.json. Run python3 tools/check.py; add focused boundary/reset/protocol
tests under tests/reviewer/ if useful. Do not change RTL, task or public checker,
read other projects/final evaluators, or invoke extra models/agents. Your time
shares the original 1200-second frontend budget with the designer. Write
reports/review.json and return NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"report":{"subject":"benchmark-rtl",
"verdict":"passed or failed","repair_summary":"concrete findings"}}.
Use an actual verdict. Failed findings go back to the original designer.

payload.content:
# fifo8x4

Implement benchmark_fifo, 4 entries of 8 bits, one rising-edge clock.
Active-low asynchronous reset makes the FIFO empty. Read data is the current
head combinationally, and zero when empty. full/empty reflect current occupancy.
At an edge, accept push iff wr_en && !full; accept pop iff rd_en && !empty,
using flags BEFORE the edge. Thus simultaneous read/write on full accepts only
the read; on empty accepts only the write. No fall-through, overwrite or underflow.
Preserve exact insertion order. Memory reset is not required; externally visible
outputs after reset must meet the empty/zero contract.

Use the fixed top-level port names and widths in interface.json. Develop with
`python3 tools/check.py`. Deliver synthesizable RTL under rtl/. Independent
final vectors/reference and scoring are outside your workspace. Do not alter
the task/checker, invoke extra models, or read other trials. The task's area
limit is installed after reference physical calibration, before evaluation.

payload.repair_summary: No defects found. Public checker passed 144 checks. Independent tests passed 168084 cycles and 622700 checks covering boundaries, simultaneous operations, ordering, wraparound, and asynchronous reset. Verilator lint passed. Evidence: reports/review.json. RTL and protected inputs remain unchanged.
